title: FlashSampling: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2603.15854v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Sampling from a categorical distribution is mathematically simple, but in large-vocabulary decoding, it often triggers extra memory traffic and extra kernels after the LM head. We present FlashSampling, an exact sampling primitive that fuses sampling into the LM-head matmul and never materializes the logits tensor in HBM. The method is simple: compute logits tile-by-tile on chip, add Gumbel noise, keep only one maximizer per row and per vocabulary tile, and finish with a small reduction over tiles. In tensor-parallel decoding, FlashSampling replaces the all-gather of logits with streaming peer-to-peer writes: This overlaps GPU-to-GPU communication with computation and HBM loads across up to 8 GPUs, with near-ideal scaling at large batch sizes. translated_title: FlashSampling：快速且内存高效的确切采样
translated_abstract: arXiv:2603.15854v4 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：从分类分布中进行采样在数学上很简单，但在大词表解码场景中，它通常会在语言模型输出头（LM head）之后触发额外的内存流量和额外的内核调用。我们提出了FlashSampling，这是一种精确的采样原语，它将采样融合到LM头的矩阵乘法中，并且从不在HBM（高带宽显存）中物化logits张量。该方法十分简单：在芯片上逐块计算logits，添加Gumbel噪声，每行和每个词表块仅保留一个最大值，最后通过对各块进行小型归约完成采样。在张量并行解码中，FlashSampling用流式点对点写入取代了logits的all-gather（全收集）：这使得GPU到GPU的通信与计算和HBM加载相重叠，最多可扩展至8个GPU，并在大批量规模下实现接近理想的扩展性。我们的内核是精确的，因为argmax可以在分区上进行分解；针对在线和张量并行设置的分组变体通过分类分布的层次化分解同样保证了精确性。
tldr: FlashSampling将精确采样融合进LM头的矩阵乘法运算中，通过在片上逐块计算并添加Gumbel噪声避免在显存中物化logits张量，并以流式点对点通信替代all-gather，实现了跨最多8个GPU的快速、精确且内存高效的大词表采样。
en_tdlr: FlashSampling is an exact sampling primitive that fuses categorical sampling into the LM-head matmul, never materializing logits in HBM and replacing all-gather with streaming peer-to-peer writes for fast, memory-efficient sampling across up to 8 GPUs.
